theorem quantization_rigidity_of_oneSided_rational_phase {lam : ℕ → ℝ}

    (hphase : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x →
      cexp (((2 * Real.pi * quantizationResidualCumulative hW x : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) =
        ∑' k : ℕ, p k * cexp (((2 * (k : ℝ) * Real.log ((u : ℝ) / v) * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * I)) :
    (∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n → lam n = ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n) ∧ RiemannHypothesis

theorem quantization_rigidity_of_oneSided_rational_phase {lam : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) {u v : ℕ} (hv : 1 ≤ v) (hvu : v < u)
    (huv : u.Coprime v) {p : ℕ → ℂ}
    (hp : Summable fun k => ‖p k‖ * ((u : ℝ) / v) ^ k)
    (hphase : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x →
      cexp (((2 * Real.pi * quantizationResidualCumulative hW x : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) =
        ∑' k : ℕ, p k * cexp (((2 * (k : ℝ) * Real.log ((u : ℝ) / v) * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * I)) :
    (∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n → lam n = ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n) ∧ RiemannHypothesis
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  have hu : 2 ≤ u := by omega
  obtain ⟨hp0, hrows⟩ := quantization_phase_rational_rows hW hv hvu huv hp hphase
  let c : ℕ → ℂ := fun k =>
    p k * (Real.exp ((2 * (k : ℝ) * Real.log ((u : ℝ) / v)) / 4) : ℂ)
  have hc : c 0 ≠ 0 := by simpa [c] using hp0
  have hc0 : c 0 = p 0 := by simp [c]
  have hvdep := quantization_rational_rows_classification hu hv huv hc
    (a := dirichletExp (lamLog lam)) (by simpa only [c, hc0] using hrows)
  obtain ⟨b, hb1, hb, hba⟩ := quantization_exists_power_quotient hu
    (a := dirichletExp (lamLog lam)) dirichletExp_zero
    (dirichletExp_one (lamLog_zero lam) (lamLog_one lam)) hvdep
  have hcoef : WeilSingularArithmetic.forwardCoeff lam = dirichletExp (lamLog lam) := by
    unfold WeilSingularArithmetic.forwardCoeff
    congr 1
    funext n
    simp only [logZetaCoeff, lamLog]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  have hsupp := quantization_source_logarithmic_support hW hb1 hb
    (fun n => (hba n).trans (congrFun hcoef n).symm)
  have hΛ : ∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n → lam n = ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n := by
    apply eq_vonMangoldt_of_weilPositiveFull_of_threeHalves_lacunary hW
      (n := fun j => u ^ (j+1)) (by simpa using hu)
    · intro j
      rw [pow_succ u (j+1)]
      calc
        3 * u^(j+1) ≤ (2*u) * u^(j+1) :=
          Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (by omega : 3 ≤ 2*u)
        _ = 2 * (u^(j+1) * u) := by ring
    · intro n hn hnp
      apply hsupp n hn
      rintro ⟨j, hj⟩
      cases j with
      | zero => simp at hj; omega
      | succ j => exact hnp j hj
  refine ⟨hΛ, riemannHypothesis_iff_weilPositiveFull_vonMangoldt.mpr ?_⟩
  intro f hf hfc
  rw [weilFullFunctional_congr (lam' := lam) (fun n hn => (hΛ n hn).symm)]
  exact hW f hf hfc

    {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) {τ : ℂ} (hτre : 0 < τ.re) (hτ1 : 1 ≤ ‖τ‖) {b : ℝ} (hb : b ≤ -1) :
    ‖(∫ t in Iic b, quantizationTraceF hW (2 * t) * pairKernel (2 * t) τ) -
      dirichletExp (lamLog lam) m * ∫ t in Iic b, rhoMain m τ t‖ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) *

by
  have hc := norm_quantization_halfline_two_mul_sub_right hW hC hF hτre hτ1 hb
  have hs := hasSum_edgeTerm
    (fun σ hσ => WeilMeanSquare.summable_abs_div_rpow_of_weilPositiveFull hW (σ := σ) hσ)
    (fun _ hz => quantizationContinuation_eq_arch hW hz)
    (fun _ hz => hasDerivAt_quantizationCompletion hW hz) (quantizationCompletion_two hW)
    hτre hτ1 (B := 2 * b) (by linarith)

        (1 / 2 : ℂ) * ∫ y in Iic (2 * b), edgeIntegrand (quantizationCompletion hW) τ (edgePt y)) +
      (1 / 2 : ℂ) * ∑' n, if n = m then 0 else edgeTerm (dirichletExp (lamLog lam)) τ (2 * b) n := by
    rw [← hs.tsum_eq, hs.summable.tsum_eq_add_tsum_ite m, edgeTerm_resonant _ hm]
    ring
  rw [he]
  refine (norm_add_le _ _).trans ?_
  rw [norm_mul, show ‖(1 / 2 : ℂ)‖ = 1 / 2 by simp]
  linarith

    (huv : u.Coprime v) {p : ℤ → ℂ}

by
  have hz (j : ℤ) (hj : j ≠ 0) : p j = 0 :=
    quantization_bilateral_rational_harmonic_zero hW (by omega) hv huv hp hphase hj
  have hsum (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
      (∑' j : ℤ, p j * quantizationFrequencyResidue lam
        (2 * (j : ℝ) * Real.log ((u : ℝ) / v)) m) =
      p 0 * dirichletExp (lamLog lam) m := by
    rw [tsum_eq_single 0]
    · simp [quantizationFrequencyResidue_zero hm]
    · intro j hj
      rw [hz j hj, zero_mul]

    have he := hrows m (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hm)
    rw [hsum m (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hm)] at he
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ hne (he.trans (mul_one (p 0)).symm)
  exact vonMangoldt_and_RH_of_coeff_eq_one
    (fun σ hσ => WeilMeanSquare.summable_abs_div_rpow_of_weilPositiveFull hW (σ := σ) hσ)
    (differentiableOn_weilContinuation hW) (fun _ hs => quantizationContinuation_eq_arch hW hs)

by
  letI : NeZero p := ⟨hp.ne_zero⟩
  obtain ⟨ell, hell0, hell⟩ := exists_valuation_log_endpoints hW hp
  obtain ⟨r, K, eta, hr, _, _, ht, _⟩ := exists_coprime_source_ratio_limit hW p
  refine ⟨ell, r, hell0, hr, hell, fun k => ?_⟩
  have hf (σ : ℝ) (hσ : 1 < σ) :
      LSeriesSummable (nonCoprimePart p (lamLog lam)) (σ : ℂ) :=
    summable_nonCoprimePart p (lseriesSummable_of_le (norm_lamLog_le lam)
      (fun _ h => WeilMeanSquare.summable_abs_div_rpow_of_weilPositiveFull hW h) hσ)
  have hb := tendsto_valuationPart_dirichletExp hp
    (show nonCoprimePart p (lamLog lam) 0 = 0 by simp [nonCoprimePart, lamLog_zero])

source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  have hl {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) : LSeriesSummable (lamLog lam) s :=
    lseriesSummable_of_le (norm_lamLog_le lam)
      (fun _ hσ => WeilMeanSquare.summable_abs_div_rpow_of_weilPositiveFull hW hσ) hs
  have ha {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) :=
    LSeries_dirichletExp (lamLog_zero lam) (lamLog_one lam) (hl hs)
  have hb {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) := LSeries_dirichletExp
    (show nonCoprimePart p (lamLog lam) 0 = 0 by simp [nonCoprimePart, lamLog_zero])
    (show nonCoprimePart p (lamLog lam) 1 = 0 by simp [nonCoprimePart])
    (summable_nonCoprimePart p (hl hs))
  have hc {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) :
      LSeries (coprimePart p (dirichletExp (lamLog lam))) s =
        cexp (LSeries (coprimePart p (lamLog lam)) s) := by
    rw [coprimePart_dirichletExp]
    exact (LSeries_dirichletExp
      (show coprimePart p (lamLog lam) 0 = 0 by simp [coprimePart, lamLog_zero])
      (show coprimePart p (lamLog lam) 1 = 0 by simp [coprimePart, lamLog_one])
      (summable_coprimePart p (hl hs))).2
  have hsplit : nonCoprimePart p (lamLog lam) + coprimePart p (lamLog lam) = lamLog lam := by
    rw [nonCoprimePart_eq_sub]
    abel
  have h2 : 1 < (2 : ℂ).re := by norm_num
  have habs := (ha h2).1
  have hconv := (hb h2).1.convolution (summable_coprimePart p habs)
  funext n
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  · subst n
    simp [sourceCoeff, dirichletExp_zero]
  apply LSeries.eq_of_LSeries_eventually_eq
    (lt_of_le_of_lt habs.abscissaOfAbsConv_le (by simp))
    (lt_of_le_of_lt hconv.abscissaOfAbsConv_le (by simp)) ?_ hn
  filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop (1 : ℝ)] with σ hσ
  rw [LSeries_convolution' (hb hσ).1 (summable_coprimePart p (ha hσ).1),
    (ha hσ).2, (hb hσ).2, hc hσ, ← Complex.exp_add]
  rw [← LSeries_add (summable_nonCoprimePart p (hl hσ)) (summable_coprimePart p (hl hσ)), hsplit]

    (hp : Summable fun j => ‖p j‖ * Real.exp (|ω j| / 2))
    (hphase : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x →
      cexp (((2 * Real.pi * quantizationResidualCumulative hW x : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) =
        ∑' j, p j * cexp (((ω j * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * I))
    (hno : ¬∃ j : ι, ∃ m n : ℕ, p j ≠ 0 ∧ 1 ≤ m ∧ 1 ≤ n ∧ m ≠ n ∧
      ω j = 2 * Real.log ((m : ℝ) / n)) :
    (∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n → lam n = ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n) ∧ RiemannHypothesis

    (hp : Summable fun j => ‖p j‖ * Real.exp (|ω j| / 2))
    (hphase : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x →
      cexp (((2 * Real.pi * quantizationResidualCumulative hW x : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) =
        ∑' j, p j * cexp (((ω j * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * I))
    (hno : ¬∃ j : ι, ∃ m n : ℕ, p j ≠ 0 ∧ 1 ≤ m ∧ 1 ≤ n ∧ m ≠ n ∧

source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  classical
  let c : ℂ := ∑' j, if ω j = 0 then p j else 0
  have hsum (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
      (∑' j, p j * quantizationFrequencyResidue lam (ω j) m) =
        c * dirichletExp (lamLog lam) m := by
    rw [show c * dirichletExp (lamLog lam) m =
      ∑' j, (if ω j = 0 then p j else 0) * dirichletExp (lamLog lam) m from
        tsum_mul_right.symm]
    apply tsum_congr
    intro j
    by_cases hpj : p j = 0
    · simp [hpj]
    by_cases hω : ω j = 0
    · simp [hω, quantizationFrequencyResidue_zero hm]
    have hnone : ¬∃ n, quantizationFrequencyResonates (ω j) m n := by
      rintro ⟨n, hn, he⟩
      have hmn : m ≠ n := by
        intro h
        subst m
        exact hω (by linarith)
      apply hno ⟨j, m, n, hpj, hm, hn, hmn, ?_⟩
      rw [Real.log_div (by exact_mod_cast (show m ≠ 0 by omega))
        (by exact_mod_cast (show n ≠ 0 by omega))]
      linarith
    simp only [quantizationFrequencyResidue, dif_neg hnone, if_neg hω, mul_zero, zero_mul]
  obtain ⟨hne, hrows⟩ := quantization_phase_resonance_constant hW hp hphase
  rw [hsum 1 le_rfl, dirichletExp_one (lamLog_zero lam) (lamLog_one lam), mul_one] at hne hrows
  have hone (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≠ 0) : dirichletExp (lamLog lam) m = 1 := by
    have he := hrows m (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hm)
    rw [hsum m (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hm)] at he
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ hne (he.trans (mul_one c).symm)
  exact vonMangoldt_and_RH_of_coeff_eq_one
    (fun σ hσ => WeilMeanSquare.summable_abs_div_rpow_of_weilPositiveFull hW (σ := σ) hσ)
    (differentiableOn_weilContinuation hW) (fun _ hs => quantizationContinuation_eq_arch hW hs)
    (fun _ hs => hasDerivAt_quantizationCompletion hW hs) (quantizationCompletion_two hW) hone

theorem exists_ordinary_reciprocal {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) :
    ∃ G : ℂ → ℂ, DifferentiableOn ℂ G {s : ℂ | 1 / 2 < s.re} ∧
      (∀ s : ℂ, 1 < s.re →
        G s = cexp (-LSeries (logZetaCoeff (fun n => if 2 ≤ n then lam n else 0)) s)) ∧
      G 1 = 0 ∧
      ∀ s : ℂ, 1 / 2 < s.re →
        Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N,
          LSeries.term (producerMobius (fun n => if 2 ≤ n then lam n else 0)) s n)
          atTop (𝓝 (G s))

by
  let lam' : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => if 2 ≤ n then lam n else 0
  let b : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => producerMobius lam' (n + 1)
  let U : Set ℂ := {s : ℂ | 1 / 2 < s.re}
  have hUopen : IsOpen U := isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re
  have hH := WeilSpectral.herglotzWeilPositive_of_weilPositiveFull hW
  have hA : DifferentiableOn ℂ zetaArchimedeanDatum U :=
    differentiableOn_zetaArchimedeanDatum.mono fun s (hs : 1 / 2 < s.re) =>
      show 0 < s.re by linarith
  obtain ⟨Φ, hΦd, -, hΦid⟩ := hH.herglotz
  obtain ⟨c, P, -, hPd, hGL⟩ := exists_reciprocalZeta_primitive hH
    (by simp [lam'] : lam' 1 = 0) hA hΦd hΦid
  let G : ℂ → ℂ := fun s => c * ((s - 1) * cexp (P s))
  have hGd : DifferentiableOn ℂ G U := fun s hs =>
    ((((hasDerivAt_id' s).sub_const 1).mul (hPd s hs).cexp).const_mul c).differentiableAt
      |>.differentiableWithinAt
  have hconv : ∀ s ∈ U, DirichletConvergesAt b s :=
    fun _ hs => reciprocal_dirichletConvergesAt hW hs
  have hDd : DifferentiableOn ℂ (dirichletSum b) U := by
    intro s hs
    let s₀ : ℂ := (((1 / 2 + s.re) / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)
    have hs₀U : s₀ ∈ U := by
      change 1 / 2 < ((1 / 2 + s.re) / 2 : ℝ)
      change 1 / 2 < s.re at hs
      linarith
    have hlt : s₀.re < s.re := by
      change ((1 / 2 + s.re) / 2 : ℝ) < s.re
      change 1 / 2 < s.re at hs
      linarith
    have hopen : IsOpen {z : ℂ | s₀.re < z.re} :=
      isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re
    exact ((differentiableOn_dirichletSum (hconv s₀ hs₀U)).differentiableAt
      (hopen.mem_nhds hlt)).differentiableWithinAt
  have hagreeR : ∀ s : ℂ, 1 < s.re → dirichletSum b s = G s := by
    intro s hs
    obtain ⟨hLS, hLeq⟩ := LSeries_producerMobius hH.summable hs
    have hhas : HasSum (fun n => LSeries.term (producerMobius lam') s (n + 1))
        (LSeries (producerMobius lam') s) := by
      have := (hasSum_nat_add_iff' 1).mpr hLS.LSeriesHasSum
      simpa [LSeries.term_zero] using this
    have htend : Tendsto (fun N => dirichletPartialSum b N s) atTop
        (𝓝 (LSeries (producerMobius lam') s)) := by
      refine hhas.tendsto_sum_nat.congr fun N => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ => ?_
      exact term_succ_eq (producerMobius lam') s n
    rw [tendsto_nhds_unique (tendsto_dirichletSum ⟨_, htend⟩) htend, hLeq]
    exact (hGL s hs).symm
  have hagree : EqOn (dirichletSum b) G U := by
    have h2U : (2 : ℂ) ∈ U := by change (1 : ℝ) / 2 < (2 : ℂ).re; norm_num
    refine (hDd.analyticOnNhd hUopen).eqOn_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq
      (hGd.analyticOnNhd hUopen) (convex_halfSpace_re_gt (1 / 2)).isPreconnected h2U ?_
    have hV : IsOpen {s : ℂ | 1 < s.re} :=
      isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re
    filter_upwards [hV.mem_nhds (show 1 < (2 : ℂ).re by norm_num)] with z hz
    exact hagreeR z hz
  refine ⟨G, hGd, hGL, by simp [G], fun s hs => ?_⟩
  have htend := tendsto_dirichletSum (hconv s hs)
  rw [hagree hs] at htend
  simpa only [b, dirichletPartialSum_eq_sum_term] using htend

# Infinite-type dilation rigidity of the Weil cone

- **ID:** weil-cone-infinite-dilation-rigidity
- **Stage:** 3-formalized
- **Type:** THEOREM (Lean, unconditional, standard axioms)
- **Source:** loop rows 528–531; MUST-800 (`WeilConeDilationRealnessRigidity`, finite support)
- **Statement:** Let `a : ℕ → ℝ` with `Σ |a(n)| n^{−1/2+δ} < ∞` for some `δ > 0`, and let `v` be regular. If `Λ ⋆ a + v` is full-cone Weil-positive, then `a = δ₁` and `v = 0`. Within this class a Weil-positive completion exists iff RH.

## Why it is new
- The finite-type card (`2-fully-proven/11-rh-zero-divisor-geometry/weil-cone-finite-type-uniqueness`) covers only finitely supported `a`. Its open item L106′ is infinite type.
- The corpus abscissa rigidity (`WeilAbscissa.eq_vonMangoldt_of_weilPositiveFull_of_rpow_summable`) needs a deviation of absolute abscissa `< 1`. `Λ ⋆ (a − δ₁)` has abscissa exactly 1, so it is not covered.

## Exact conjecture and competing case

**L4.** For every original full-cone source `hW : WeilPositiveFull λ`,
if its actual residual phase has an exponentially weighted bilateral Fourier
representation with frequencies `2 k log r`, for any real `r > 1`, then
`λ(n)=Λ(n)` for `n≥2` and RH holds.

Final source theorem must package this as rigidity OR exclusion of every such
representation. A representation is not supplied by `hW` in this argument.
That producer remains **[OPEN CORE]** for the original WP04 assignment.

Competing case: `r^N` is an integer. A height `r^k` then has infinitely many
resonances, so the cycle-20 single-resonance argument is false in this case.
No finite Toeplitz inverse, positivity of coefficients, or new convergence
premise is allowed. The proof below inverts the complete Dirichlet convolution.

## Closed paper proof

Write `a=dirichletExp(lamLog λ)` and `b=dirichletExp(-lamLog λ)`.
Both Dirichlet series converge absolutely on `Re s>1`, by the already proved
source summability and `LSeries_dirichletExp`. Their product is one there.
Dirichlet-series uniqueness therefore gives `b*a=δ₁`. This includes the
zero coefficient, which vanishes in both series and in the convolution.

Let `p_k` be the represented coefficients and set
`K=Σ_k |p_k| exp(|k log r|)<∞`. For `y>0` define

    c(y)=sqrt(y) p_k when y=r^k, and c(y)=0 otherwise.

The index is unique because `r>1`. Each summand bound gives
`|p_k|≤K exp(-|k log r|)≤K exp(k log r)`. Hence
`|c(y)|≤K y^(3/2)` for every positive `y`.

The cycle-20 real-height residue is exactly

    B(x)=Σ_{n≥1} a(n)c(x/n),                    x>0.       (1)

Indeed its resonance equation is `n r^k=x`; its factor is
`sqrt(x) exp((2k log r-2log x)/4)=sqrt(r^k)`.
The double sum can be reindexed: each `k` has at most one resonant `n`,
each `n` at most one resonant `k`, and the displayed bound gives absolute
summability. More generally,

    Σ_{n,m≥1}|b(n)a(m)c(x/(nm))|
      ≤K x^(3/2)(Σ_n |b(n)|n^(-3/2))(Σ_m |a(m)|m^(-3/2))<∞.

Fubini and grouping by `nm` are thus justified and give the exact inverse

    c(x)=Σ_{n≥1} b(n)B(x/n).                              (2)

Cycle 20 proved `B(x+1)=B(x)` for every `x>0`, directly from the actual
reflected defect Laplace transform. No boundary continuity was assumed.

If rigidity already holds, stop. Otherwise L3p supplies a positive integer
power `r^J∈Q`. Call a positive real number a positive radical when some
positive integer power belongs to Q. Every `r^k`, including negative powers,
and every positive rational multiple of it, is a positive radical.

Classical algebraic fact: a positive irrational radical `x` cannot have
`x+1` a positive radical. For a proof take a common exponent `M≥1` with
`x^M,(x+1)^M∈Q`. Every complex conjugate `z` of `x` satisfies
`|z|=x` and `|z+1|=x+1`. Squaring gives `Re z=x` and then `Im z=0`.
Thus every root of the minimal polynomial is `x`. Characteristic-zero
separability forces degree one, so `x∈Q`, a contradiction.

For any positive irrational radical `x`, a resonance at `x+1` would express
it as `n r^k`, another positive radical. Thus `B(x+1)=0`, so periodicity
gives `B(x)=0`. Every `x/n` with `n≥1` is again an irrational positive
radical. Applying (2) yields `c(x)=0`. In particular,

    p_k=0 whenever r^k is irrational.                    (3)

Choose the least positive integer `N` with `r^N∈Q`; it exists by L3p.
The set `{k∈Z : r^k∈Q}` is a subgroup, so it equals `NZ`. Explicitly,
divide `k` by `N` with remainder `0≤j<N`; rationality of `r^k` and `r^N`
makes `r^j` rational, so minimality forces `j=0`.
By (3), reindex the phase with `q=r^N>1` and `p'_l=p_(Nl)`.
The required moment is a subseries of the old one because
`2 l log q=2 (Nl) log r`.

Write `q=u/v` in lowest positive terms. If `v≥2`, cycle-20 L2 applies.
If `v=1`, `u≥2` and cycle-16 L1 applies; its weight `u^|l|` equals
`exp(|2l log u|/2)`. These exhaust the cases and prove L4.

/-- The first surviving endpoint jet is exactly one, at every Gamma order. -/
theorem boundaryJet_first (N : ℕ) : boundaryJet N (2*N+3) = 1 := by
  rw [boundaryJet_eq_coeff N _ le_rfl]
  have hd : (jetPolynomial (2*N+3)).natDegree = 2*N+5 := by
    rw [jetPolynomial_degree]
  rw [← hd]
  exact (jetPolynomial_monic _).coeff_natDegree

private theorem rationalSymbol_of_ne (N : ℕ) (s : ℂ)
    (hs : ∀ i : PoleIndex N, s ≠ pole N i) :
    s*(s-1)/clearingProduct (N+3) s =
      ∑ i : PoleIndex N, residue N i/(s-pole N i) := by
  let P : Polynomial ℂ := X*(X-C 1)
  have hdeg : P.degree < (Finset.univ : Finset (PoleIndex N)).card := by
    apply (natDegree_lt_iff_degree_lt (monic_X.mul (monic_X_sub_C 1)).ne_zero).mp
    have hp : P.natDegree = 2 := by
      dsimp [P]
      rw [monic_X.natDegree_mul (monic_X_sub_C 1)]
      simp only [natDegree_X, natDegree_X_sub_C]
    rw [Finset.card_univ, pole_card, hp]
    omega
  have hP := Lagrange.eq_interpolate (pole_injective N).injOn hdeg
  have he := congrArg (fun p : Polynomial ℂ => p.eval s) hP
  rw [Lagrange.eval_interpolate_not_at_node _ (fun i _ => hs i),
    Lagrange.eval_nodal, pole_product] at he
  simp only [P, eval_mul, eval_X, eval_sub, eval_C] at he
  have hprod : clearingProduct (N+3) s ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← pole_product]
    exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun i _ => sub_ne_zero.mpr (hs i))
  rw [he, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hprod]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  simp only [Lagrange.nodalWeight, Finset.prod_inv_distrib, residue, div_eq_mul_inv]
  ring


/-- Partial fractions throughout the literal kernel's pole-free Mellin strip. -/
theorem rationalSymbol_strip (N : ℕ)
    (s : {s : ℂ // -2 < s.re ∧ s.re < 3}) :
    (s:ℂ)*((s:ℂ)-1)/clearingProduct (N+3) s =
      ∑ i : PoleIndex N, residue N i/((s:ℂ)-pole N i) := by
  apply rationalSymbol_of_ne
  intro i hi
  have hr := congrArg Complex.re hi
  cases i with
  | inl j =>
    have hj : 0 ≤ (j:ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    norm_num [pole] at hr
    linarith [s.property.1]
  | inr j =>
    have hj : 0 ≤ (j:ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    norm_num [pole] at hr
    linarith [s.property.2]

/-- The actual rational factor in the line-two Mellin symbol has these residues. -/
theorem rationalSymbol_two (N : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    (2+(t:ℂ)*I)*(1+(t:ℂ)*I)/clearingProduct (N+3) (2+(t:ℂ)*I) =
      ∑ i : PoleIndex N, residue N i/(2+(t:ℂ)*I-pole N i) := by
  have h := rationalSymbol_of_ne N (2+(t:ℂ)*I) (two_ne_pole N t)
  convert h using 1; ring

/-- Polynomial piece of the literal cosine kernel, extended for endpoint differentiation. -/
def kernelInner (N : ℕ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  -∑ j : Fin (N+3), residue N (Sum.inr j)*z^((2*(j:ℤ)+2):ℤ)

/-- Inverse-power piece of the literal cosine kernel. -/
def kernelOuter (N : ℕ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ j : Fin (N+3), residue N (Sum.inl j)*z^((-2*(j:ℤ)-3):ℤ)

private theorem zpow_jet_one (m : ℤ) (k : ℕ) :
    iteratedDeriv k (fun z : ℂ => z^m) 1 =
      ∏ j ∈ Finset.range k, ((m:ℂ)-(j:ℂ)) := by
  simpa only [iteratedDerivWithin_univ, one_zpow, mul_one] using
    iteratedDerivWithin_zpow (𝕜 := ℂ) (s := Set.univ) m k isOpen_univ (Set.mem_univ 1)

private theorem finite_zpow_jet (N k : ℕ) (c : Fin (N+3) → ℂ)
    (m : Fin (N+3) → ℤ) :
    iteratedDeriv k (fun z : ℂ => ∑ j, c j*z^(m j)) 1 =
      ∑ j, c j * ∏ l ∈ Finset.range k, ((m j:ℂ)-(l:ℂ)) := by
  have hc : ∀ j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (N+3))),
      ContDiffAt ℂ k (fun z : ℂ => c j*z^(m j)) 1 := by
    intro j hj
    apply contDiffAt_const.mul
    exact (AnalyticAt.fun_zpow (𝕜 := ℂ) (f := fun z : ℂ => z) (z := (1:ℂ))
      (n := m j) (by fun_prop) (by norm_num)).contDiffAt
  rw [iteratedDeriv_fun_sum hc]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  rw [iteratedDeriv_const_mul_field, zpow_jet_one]

/-- Algebraic endpoint jets are the actual derivatives of both kernel pieces. -/
theorem kernel_endpoint_jump (N k : ℕ) :
    iteratedDeriv k (kernelOuter N) 1 - iteratedDeriv k (kernelInner N) 1 =
      boundaryJet N k := by
  unfold kernelOuter kernelInner
  rw [iteratedDeriv_fun_neg, finite_zpow_jet, finite_zpow_jet, sub_neg_eq_add]
  unfold boundaryJet
  rw [Fintype.sum_sum_type]
  congr 1
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    congr 1
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro l hl
    simp only [pole, Int.cast_sub, Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_ofNat,
      Int.cast_natCast]
    ring
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    congr 1
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro l hl

/-!
# The actual logarithmic-polynomial theta defect

The exact residue identity becomes a finite packet with all pole orders retained.
Every interior clearing root lies in the open critical strip and contributes a
nonzero polynomial. Endpoint contributions remain explicit in the finite set.

/-- One family of polynomials represents all residues, with a sharp removability criterion. -/
theorem exists_poleCleared_residue_polynomials (P : Polynomial ℂ) {H : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hH : Differentiable ℂ H) :
    ∃ Q : ℂ → Polynomial ℂ,
      (∀ ρ : ℂ, ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x →
        laurentCoeff (fun s => (x : ℂ) ^ (-s) * poleClearedDegreeTwoCompletion P H s) ρ (-1) =
          (x : ℂ) ^ (-ρ) * (Q ρ).eval (Real.log x : ℂ)) ∧
      ∀ ρ : ℂ, Q ρ = 0 ↔ 0 ≤ meromorphicOrderAt (poleClearedDegreeTwoCompletion P H) ρ := by
  have h := fun ρ => exists_mellin_residue_polynomial (poleClearedDegreeTwoCompletion_meromorphicAt P hH ρ)
  choose Q hrep hzero using h
  exact ⟨Q, hrep, hzero⟩

/-- The original datum yields the actual finite logarithmic packet or infinitely many deficits. -/
theorem degreeThree_infiniteDeficits_or_logPolynomialDefect {g : ℕ → ℂ} {E : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hD : WeilZetaPower.ZetaPowerDatum 3 g E) (hE1 : E 1 ≠ 0) :
    (xiDeficitSupport E).Infinite ∨
      ∃ (P : Polynomial ℂ) (H : ℂ → ℂ) (ε : ℂ) (Q : ℂ → Polynomial ℂ),
        P.Monic ∧ ‖ε‖ = 1 ∧ (∀ s, E (1 - s) = ε * E s) ∧
        (∀ z, analyticOrderAt (fun w => P.eval w) z = (xiDeficit E z : ℕ∞)) ∧
        Differentiable ℂ H ∧ FiniteOrderEnvelope H ∧ H 1 ≠ 0 ∧
        (∀ z, P.eval z * E z = H z * xi z) ∧
        (∀ ρ : ℂ, Q ρ = 0 ↔ 0 ≤ meromorphicOrderAt (poleClearedDegreeTwoCompletion P H) ρ) ∧
        (∀ ρ ∈ P.roots.toFinset, 0 < ρ.re ∧ ρ.re < 1 ∧ Q ρ ≠ 0) ∧
        ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x →
          MaassThetaMellin.kTheta (degreeTwoQuotientCoeff g) x -
              ε * ((x : ℂ) ^ (-1 : ℂ) * MaassThetaMellin.kTheta (degreeTwoQuotientCoeff g) x⁻¹) =
            (1 / 4 : ℂ) * ∑ ρ ∈ degreeTwoPoleSet P,
              (x : ℂ) ^ (-ρ) * (Q ρ).eval (Real.log x : ℂ) := by
  rcases degreeThree_infiniteDeficits_or_poleCleared hD hE1 with hi | ⟨P, H, hm, _, ho, hd, hg, h₁, hf⟩
  · exact Or.inl hi
  · obtain ⟨ε, hε, he⟩ := hD.exists_sign
    obtain ⟨Q, hrep, hzero⟩ := exists_poleCleared_residue_polynomials P hd
    refine Or.inr ⟨P, H, ε, Q, hm, hε, he, ho, hd, hg, h₁, hf, hzero, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro ρ hρ
      have hp : P.eval ρ = 0 := Polynomial.isRoot_of_mem_roots (Multiset.mem_toFinset.mp hρ)
      have hr := deficitPolynomial_root_re_mem_Ioo P ho hp
      refine ⟨hr.1, hr.2, ?_⟩
      intro hq
      exact (not_le_of_gt (poleClearedDegreeTwoCompletion_order_neg_at_root
        hD.entire hE1 hd h₁ P hf ho hp)) ((hzero ρ).mp hq)
    · intro x hx
      rw [degreeTwoQuotient_theta_defect hD he P hm.ne_zero hd hg hf ho hx]
      congr 1
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ρ _ => hrep ρ x hx

theorem outer_power_integral (s : ℂ) (hs : -2 < s.re) (j : ℕ) :
    (∫ x in Ioi (1:ℝ), (x:ℂ)^(-2*(j:ℂ)-3-s)) =
      -1/(-2*(j:ℂ)-2-s) := by
  have hr : (-2*(j:ℂ)-3-s).re < -1 := by
    have hj : 0 ≤ (j:ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    norm_num
    linarith
  rw [integral_Ioi_cpow_of_lt hr zero_lt_one]
  simp only [Complex.ofReal_one, one_cpow]
  congr 1
  ring

private theorem inner_integral (N : ℕ) (s : ℂ) (hs : s.re < 3) :
    (∫ x in Ioc (0:ℝ) 1, (x:ℂ)^(-s)*kernelInner N x) =
      ∑ j : Fin (N+3), residue N (Sum.inr j)/(s-pole N (Sum.inr j)) := by
  rw [setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioc (fun x hx => inner_factor N s hx.1),
    integral_neg, integral_finsetSum _ (fun (j : Fin (N+3)) _ =>
      (inner_power_integrable s hs j).const_mul (residue N (Sum.inr j))),
    ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  rw [integral_const_mul, inner_power_integral s hs]
  simp only [pole]
  rw [show 2*(j:ℂ)+3-s = -(s-(2*(j:ℂ)+3)) by ring, div_neg]
  ring

private theorem outer_integral (N : ℕ) (s : ℂ) (hs : -2 < s.re) :
    (∫ x in Ioi (1:ℝ), (x:ℂ)^(-s)*kernelOuter N x) =
      ∑ j : Fin (N+3), residue N (Sum.inl j)/(s-pole N (Sum.inl j)) := by
  rw [setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi (fun x hx => outer_factor N s
    (zero_lt_one.trans hx)), integral_finsetSum _ (fun (j : Fin (N+3)) _ =>
      (outer_power_integrable s hs j).const_mul (residue N (Sum.inl j)))]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  rw [integral_const_mul, outer_power_integral s hs]
  simp only [pole]
  rw [show -2*(j:ℂ)-2-s = -(s-(-2*(j:ℂ)-2)) by ring, div_neg]
  ring

private theorem kernel_weighted_integral (N : ℕ) (s : ℂ)
    (hl : -2 < s.re) (hr : s.re < 3) :
    (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), (x:ℂ)^(-s)*kernel N x) =
      ∑ i : PoleIndex N, residue N i/(s-pole N i) := by
  rw [← Ioc_union_Ioi_eq_Ioi (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 by norm_num),
    setIntegral_union (Ioc_disjoint_Ioi le_rfl) measurableSet_Ioi
      ((inner_integrable N s hr).congr_fun (kernel_left N s) measurableSet_Ioc)
      ((outer_integrable N s hl).congr_fun (kernel_right N s) measurableSet_Ioi)]
  rw [← setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioc (kernel_left N s),
    ← setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi (kernel_right N s),
    inner_integral N s hr, outer_integral N s hl, Fintype.sum_sum_type, add_comm]

/-- Absolute weighted admission on the complete pole-free strip. -/
theorem integrable_kernel_strip (N : ℕ)
    (s : {s : ℂ // -2 < s.re ∧ s.re < 3}) :
    IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => (x:ℂ)^(-(s:ℂ))*kernel N x) (Ioi 0) :=
  kernel_weighted_integrable N s s.property.1 s.property.2

/-- Actual weighted Mellin integral on the complete pole-free strip. -/
theorem kernel_mellin_strip (N : ℕ)
    (s : {s : ℂ // -2 < s.re ∧ s.re < 3}) :
    (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), (x:ℂ)^(-(s:ℂ))*kernel N x) =
      (s:ℂ)*((s:ℂ)-1)/clearingProduct (N+3) s := by
  rw [kernel_weighted_integral N s s.property.1 s.property.2,
    rationalSymbol_strip]

/-- The actual kernel has zero total mass, permitting cosine subtraction. -/
theorem integral_kernel_zero (N : ℕ) :
    (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), kernel N x) = 0 := by
  simpa using kernel_mellin_strip N ⟨0, by norm_num⟩

/-- The actual piecewise kernel is absolutely integrable. -/
theorem integrable_kernel (N : ℕ) : IntegrableOn (kernel N) (Ioi 0) := by
  simpa using kernel_weighted_integrable N 0 (by norm_num) (by norm_num)

/-- The actual line-two Mellin integral is absolutely admitted at every height. -/
theorem integrable_kernel_mellin_two (N : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => (x:ℂ)^(-(2+(t:ℂ)*I))*kernel N x) (Ioi 0) :=

theorem kernel_mellin_two (N : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    (∫ x in Ioi (0:ℝ), (x:ℂ)^(-(2+(t:ℂ)*I))*kernel N x) =
      (2+(t:ℂ)*I)*(1+(t:ℂ)*I)/clearingProduct (N+3) (2+(t:ℂ)*I) := by
  rw [kernel_weighted_integral N _ (by norm_num) (by norm_num), rationalSymbol_two]

/-- Continuity of the actual piecewise kernel includes its matching endpoint. -/

  have hi : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => kernelInner N x) := by
    unfold kernelInner
    apply Continuous.neg
    apply continuous_finsetSum
    intro j hj
    apply continuous_const.mul
    exact Complex.continuous_ofReal.zpow₀ _ (fun _ => Or.inr (by omega))
  have ho : ContinuousOn (fun x : ℝ => kernelOuter N x) (Ici 1) := by
    unfold kernelOuter
    apply continuousOn_finsetSum
    intro j hj
    apply continuousOn_const.mul
    apply Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousOn.zpow₀
    intro x hx
    left
    exact_mod_cast (show x ≠ 0 by have : 1 ≤ x := hx; linarith)
  unfold kernel
  apply continuous_if
  · intro x hx
    have hx1 : x = 1 := by simpa only [show {x : ℝ | x ≤ 1} = Iic 1 by rfl,
      frontier_Iic, mem_singleton_iff] using hx
    subst x
    simpa only [iteratedDeriv_zero, Complex.ofReal_one] using
      (kernel_endpoint_match N ⟨0, by omega⟩).symm
